summary: AGM Group Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to timely file its annual Form 20-F for FY2025, violating Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The notice has no immediate effect on listing; the company has 60 days to submit a compliance plan and may receive up to 180 days extension until November 11, 2026. The filing is a routine compliance disclosure regarding late filing, not a special situation event. This is a standard Nasdaq notification with no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. As a non-US issuer, the Form 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. Form 8-K for material events.
